newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian Rigas Raugs 1996 profit 187,000 lats.
newsitem.headline: Latvian Rigas Raugs 1996 profit 187,000 lats.

text.p: One of Latvia's key corporate shares on the stock exchange, the Rigas Raugs yeast company, said it made a 1996 profit of 187,000 lats but could not provide comparisons.
A company spokesman said the firm went public only in 1995 and does not have any previous figures with which to compare current earnings. He said the figures were unaudited.

The spokesman added that the company, quoted on the secondary list of the stock market, had turnover of 1.3 million lats in 1996. Rigas Raugs has been one of the most traded shares on the bourse, where almost 30 stocks are traded.
